notes: Ice Lance - "instead" means an already-Frozen target is damaged and NOT re-frozen

Shadow Madness - it may attack at once because TakeControl(ready) clears its summoning sickness (not Charge, which a Silence would take away). Handed back at end of turn; if its owner's board is full then, it is destroyed, as in Hearthstone.
Light of the Naaru - EX1_001 is Lightwarden; the check reads the target AFTER the heal
Quartermaster - CS2_101t is the Silver Hand Recruit token; the buff is by card id
column8: so Recruits made by any source count

notes: Thoughtsteal - COPIES, so the opponent's deck is untouched; no type filter because the printed text says "cards", not minions
Echo of Medivh - CopyToHand takes the PRINTED card, so a buffed minion echoes as its printed self
Duplicate - the secret is pulled from the zone before its ops run, so a board wipe copies only the FIRST friendly minion to die, as in Hearthstone
Webspinner - all 32 collectible BEAST cards in the pin are minions, so the race term's implied type=MINION costs nothing
Unstable Portal - the discount is an enchantment on that generated copy, so it rides with the card and discounts nothing else

Eye for an Eye - payloadAmount is the amount the event carried; a trigger's fresh ctx cannot see `dealt`. PayloadTargetIsMyHero tests ownership, so the opponent damaging their OWN hero does not arm it

Blessing of Wisdom - PayloadAttackerIsSelf is essential: without it the trigger fires on EVERY attack on the board. CasterTrigger: the CASTER draws, also when the blessed minion is an enemy's (EX1_363e / EX1_363e2).
Holy Wrath - lastDrawn names the card Draw(1) just made; an empty deck draws nothing, so lastDrawn is nil and the damage resolves to 0 rather than erroring

Divine Favor - PlayCard removes the spell from hand BEFORE the block runs, so friendly.hand already excludes Divine Favor itself. sub() clamps at zero, so a bigger hand than the opponent's draws nothing
Feign Death - fires them without killing; granted deathrattles count because the op reads the live entity's list
Auchenai Soulpriest - a top-level script field the engine reads, not ops it runs. Game:Heal routes through DealDamage when set, so Divine Shield, armor and real deaths all behave

Noble Sacrifice - EX1_130a is the 2/1 Defender token. PRE_ATTACK, not ATTACK_DECLARED: Game:Attack re-reads its defender straight after PRE_ATTACK, and only secrets resolve inline there. With a full board Summon returns nothing, lastSummoned stays empty and the retarget is a no-op -- the secret is still spent, as in Hearthstone
